steps.note: Inspect. The records in scope are listed, and any skipped file is reported.
Partition. The records are cut into chunks, each read on its own.
Map. Each chunk is checked against this skill's rules, one chunk at a time.
Gate. A change needs a named service, an approver for its risk level and a rollback.
Verify. Each cited line is re-read, and a finding that does not hold is dropped.
Report. Status: draft for the owner to review. It is not a decision.

outcome.verdict: 1 change cannot be approved as written

findings.title: Approver missing for the risk level
findings.fix: Name the approver before the change

example:
Illustrative example: the items and results are made up, not real output.
Summary: 3 findings (1 high, 1 medium, 1 low).
[high] chg-442.md:12  Approver missing for the risk level.
       Fix: Name the approver before the change.
[medium] chg-445.md:19  Impact names no affected service.
       Fix: Name the services affected.
[low] chg-443.md:26  No rollback described.
       Fix: Write the rollback steps.
Not checked: Whether the change works.
pros: Flags a request with no rollback, an impact with no affected service named, and an approver missing for the risk level.
cons: Not checked: Whether the change works.
input: The records for this review, as text or CSV
output: A draft report: findings with location, fix and a not-checked list
prompt: Use the rlm-techops-change-request skill on the records for this review.
